'''Corrupted rats''' are low-level monsters found in the [[The Gauntlet#Corrupted Gauntlet|Corrupted Gauntlet]]. Their counterpart in the [[The Gauntlet|Gauntlet]] is the [[crystalline rat]]. Up to 3 low-level monsters spawn in a room.
